messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, proposal for 2027 onward
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our need is 4580 pcs per year, and we propose a 24- or 36-month commitment. Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 records a 10.3 % volume change. The should-cost estimate cost:350020 puts your unit cost at 403.21 EUR, clearly below your quoted price. Every attached package remains above our current contract price, so no price reduction is involved. In return we offer long-term planning security, as you asked for flexibility on terms.

As your proposed increase exceeds 2 %, could your pricing committee review these packages? What is your earliest possible lead time?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, proposal for 2027 onward
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.

Our offer provides a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month commitment and are willing to accommodate the 60-day payment terms. In consideration of this long-term planning security and your provided data, we can offer a revised price of €430.68 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €430.68 per unit.

Our team will address your inquiry regarding the earliest possible lead time separately. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting our data. To confirm our commitment: 4580 pcs per year, over 24 or 36 months, as in the attached packages.

All three packages remain above our current contract price, so they do not require a price reduction. They give you secured volume over a longer term. As the change from our current contract exceeds 2 %, could your pricing committee review these packages at its next meeting?

If your 36-month option is more attractive for you, please make it your primary standing offer. Could you also tell us your earliest possible lead time, and whether a cheaper variant of the converter is available?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For your information:
We appreciate your focus on the 36-month commitment and 60-day payment terms, which we have now made our primary offer.
As our management has frozen price reductions, the unit price for this package must remain at €430.68.
Our specialists will address your questions regarding the earliest possible lead time and alternative technical variants separately.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.68 per unit.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for making the 36-month package your primary offer. Our commitment stays at 4580 pcs per year for 36 months, or 24 months as an alternative, with 90 days payment, as in the attached sheets.

Your scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 84.6 %, which carries planning cost on our side over a long commitment.

All packages remain above our current contract price, so the reduction freeze does not apply. Could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting? We would also welcome your specialists' reply on the earliest lead time and any cheaper variant.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
